ruleset.name: Chato
ruleset.description: Branching that takes nuance to read is banned; each message names the fix.

rule.message: {0} {1} is too hard to follow (cognitive complexity {2}, limit {3}). Split it into named methods, return early instead of nesting, or replace a branch chain with a lookup map or a switch on an enum. Do not suppress.
If statements nest too deep. Return early, or move the inner branch into a named method.
Merge the nested if into one condition with &&, or name the condition with a method.

rule.name: IfInsideSwitch
rule.message: An if inside a switch case hides a second decision. Move the case body into a named method, or make the condition part of what you switch on.
rule.description: No if statements inside switch cases.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: ElseIfChain
rule.message: This if has two or more else-if branches. Use a switch, a lookup map, or one method per case with early returns.
rule.description: No if / else if / else if chains.
